title: Aspire Cleito RTA System
description: The Aspire Cleito RTA System allows you to customise your Cleito coil builds, transforming your Cleito tank into a versatile, rebuildable tank atomiser (RTA) system. Simply screw the Cleito RTA into your own Cleito tank in place of a replaceable coil head. The Cleito RTA deck comes with a pre-built, dual Clapton coil setup. The Cleito RTA System is a Velocity-style deck with two terminal posts which allows for easy rebuilding. Expect impressive cloud production and intense flavour.
